summary: Learn value stream mapping and waste reduction with practical exercises, Lean tools, and action planning. Build maps, cut waste, and improve flow.
lede: Value stream mapping gives operations and service professionals a way to examine end-to-end flow and locate waiting, rework, and other waste. This training shows how to collect process data, calculate takt and lead times, create current- and future-state maps, prioritize waste, and turn findings into kaizen actions and an improvement plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to map flow, identify waste, and drive practical improvement in operational or service processes.
prerequisites: You should have access to a process you can describe clearly, basic timing or workflow data if available, and a laptop for template-based exercises. A spreadsheet tool and the ability to review a sample process map are sufficient for the hands-on work.
